## Probe #6 batch + first-hour chrome residuals

Builds on **0.1.21** with the mid-cycle probe #6 acceptance batch and the round-7 P3 residuals.

### Probe #6 (accepted @ d3bafe4)
- **Save All** — File menu, palette, Ctrl+K S; multi-dirty quit offers Save All / Don't Save / Cancel
- **Open Recent** — File ▸ Open Recent + palette picker
- **Explorer context** — Rename / Delete / Copy Path / Open to the Side
- **F2 Rename** — works with an explorer selection (even after editor focus)
- **Palette aliases** — `replace`, `goto line`, maximize panel
- **Toggle Maximized Panel** — enlarge the bottom terminal panel
- **Dirty + disk** — Reload / Overwrite / Compare when the file changes underneath
- **Status bar** — LF / language / indent pickers
- **Outline + breadcrumbs** — View ▸ Outline and editor path crumbs
- **Split Editor** — Right / Down (regression check)

### Round-7 residuals (this release)
- **Preview palette aliases** — queries `markdown preview`, `toggle preview`, `open preview` hit Preview / Toggle editor and preview / Editor and preview
- **Linux Alt+letter menubar** — Alt+F / Alt+E / Alt+V (and Alt+G / Alt+O / Alt+H) open File / Edit / View / Go / Format / Help
- **Inline F2 rename** — explorer rename edits the name in the tree row (Enter commits, Esc cancels)
- **Problems panel** — palette / View ▸ Problems lists Typst diagnostics and spell issues (empty state when clean)
- **Toggle Minimap** — setting + View / palette command shows a clickable overview strip beside the editor

### Deferred
- Minimap is a density overview (click-to-jump), not a full glyph-faithful VS Code minimap
- Format menu mnemonic is **Alt+O** (File already takes Alt+F)
